judgment.reason: The agent understood the multi-provider scraping task and produced a JSON-like artifact with many requested fields, but it did not satisfy the specific Vodafone tier requirement: the final artifact returns 25GB, 35GB, 100GB, 120GB, and Unlimited instead of the requested 10GB, 30GB, 100GB, 280GB, and Unlimited, and it merely notes that 280GB was not selectable despite trace evidence showing 280GB appeared on Vodafone pages/footnotes. This leaves a material required subset incomplete, so the outcome is not fully supported as a completed scrape of the requested packages.

observations.finding: AX radio checked true/false fields reached model-native tool output. Generated selection helpers did not explicitly read AX checked state; separate DOM inspection did read input.checked.
AX radio click failed as covered for clipped native input. Explicit associated-label click then succeeded; DOM showed young=true and consumer=false. Visible young tiers were 20GB,100GB,Unlimited.
Two later stale explicit-label selectors failed. DOM still showed young selected and bundle eligibility false; no 280GB option among the captured controls.

280GB found in source HTML/footnotes: GigaMobil Young L and historical 2024 roaming terms. CSS breakpoint 1280 also contaminated the first loose text search. Footnotes do not establish a currently selectable 280GB offer.

Helper chose young input-group name conditionally but swallowed selection failures and did not assert selected eligibility. Output vfYoung was empty. This is not successful young configuration extraction.
Young landing page displayed an adblocker warning and 20GB/100GB/Unlimited controls. Current UI selectability of 280GB remains unproven.
Final artifact delivered adult 25GB/35GB/100GB/120GB/Unlimited alternatives with caveats. Official missing-required-fields zero retained.
